_comment: The two GLOBAL Jira workflows, the one workflow scheme, and both tiers' screens, screen schemes, issue type screen schemes, issue type schemes and project categories this repository owns. universal-apply.sh converges a Jira site towards this file; universal-switch.sh reads 'tiers' to move a project onto one.

Additive only: a missing status, transition, validator, scheme mapping, screen field or issue type is added, a missing object is created, and nothing already in Jira is ever changed or removed. Whatever Jira holds that this file does not name is reported as 'not in spec (left alone)'.

field_sets lists screen fields by id, or {field:<name>} for a custom field. 'standard' is the Jira Scrum template's default issue screen without the contract fields; 'contract' is every custom field of BINDING.md section 2.
Status and issue-type names are resolved to site ids at run time. {field:<name>} in a validator parameter resolves to that custom field's id via GET /field.
A transition is identified by (from, to), never by its name. from is null only for the initial transition, the one Jira runs on create.

No transition carries system:previous-status-validator: the task workflow's transitions are DIRECTED, so reaching Completed through Awaiting Deployment is structural (owner decision 2026-09-26, reversing NWM-110). There is no In Progress -> Completed transition: every ticket occupies Awaiting Deployment before Completed (work-order MUST-27). Every transition into Open requires verify.
The grouping workflow carries no validator by design: Epics and Sub-tasks are not tickets.

actions are post-functions, matched by ruleKey + parameters like validators. system:update-field on resolution sets it on every transition into Completed or Done ({resolution:Done}) and Cancelled ({resolution:Won't Do}), and clears it (value "") on every re-open and re-work and on each grouping or Simplified transition back out of a terminal status. {resolution:<name>} resolves to that resolution's id via GET /resolution. A set is declared with mode "replace" because Jira stores it that way whatever mode is sent (measured 2026-09-26); a clear keeps mode "".
The Simplified workflow's name typo is its live name; it is declared here only for its resolution actions.
